resultFields.label: Local env present
resultFields.rawValuePolicy: Do not commit .env.local contents, shell exports, copied secret values, or command output containing local private context.

resultFields.label: Generated directory present
resultFields.rawValuePolicy: Do not commit generated API file contents, generated import snippets, or generatedApiAvailable true state.

resultFields.label: Hosted env visible
resultFields.rawValuePolicy: Do not commit deployment URLs, auth issuer values, client ids, tokens, provider identifiers, 1Password item contents, or copied dashboard values.

resultFields.label: External writes
resultFields.commitPolicy: Committed value must be 0 before owner approval.
resultFields.rawValuePolicy: Do not commit provider request logs, provider response logs, mutation output, or resource ids.

resultFields.label: Hosted deployment touched
resultFields.commitPolicy: Committed value must be false in prepare-only packets.
resultFields.rawValuePolicy: Do not commit deployment ids, dashboard details, hosted query output, or hosted mutation output.

resultFields.label: Preflight result status
resultFields.commitPolicy: Commit only the enum status plus a short sanitized note.
resultFields.rawValuePolicy: Do not commit raw command logs, stack traces with local paths, provider output, token-like strings, URLs, or secret-bearing diagnostics.

commitRules: Commit only the six sanitized fields and a short sanitized note.
Keep raw command output outside committed source if it contains local paths, private provider context, hosted identifiers, or secret-like values.
Do not use this template as approval to run the hosted activation preflight.
Do not run codegen, import generated API bindings, execute live Convex, switch adapters, or perform provider writes from this template.
nextGate: Owner approves the hosted preflight window and the private storage location for raw command output before any real hosted env values are used.
